purpose: TOOLS-01 machine-readable matrix: inventory of the current tool schemas, limits, context dispositions, effects and platform behavior as of this commit. The code remains authoritative; this file is the ACI specification input for TOOLS-02/03/04.

path.note: workspace-relative; resolved through the confinement check

cursor.note: opaque token from a previous fs.list result; serves the next page from that call's snapshot artifact

limits.note: when the listing overflows the page it spills the full sorted snapshot to an artifact and returns a cursor; later pages are served from the immutable snapshot, so directory changes between pages cannot cause duplicates or gaps
file larger than max_read_bytes is rejected outright (use a narrower tool)

output.revision: SHA-256 hex of the file bytes; stable for identical content, changes with any edit — the edit.patch base_revision precondition is checked against it

platform.note: directory-handle-relative confined open; reparse/link swap rejected at open time (CORE-07)

reference.note: artifact:// reference returned by another tool (spilled listings, grep hit sets, process logs)

limits.note: reference confined to .focus-agent/artifacts; foreign schemes, query/fragment components and traversal refused; the read itself is byte-capped (append-only artifacts cannot grow past the bound between a size probe and the read); non-UTF-8 content shown lossily

output.paging: metadata has_more / next_start_line let the model walk a spilled snapshot one page at a time without guessing filesystem paths

platform.note: open goes through the pinned directory-handle descent (CORE-07)

cursor.note: opaque token from a previous search.grep result; serves the next page from that call's snapshot artifact

limits.note: hit sets above model_hits spill to an artifact and return a cursor; later pages are served from the immutable snapshot, so file changes between pages cannot cause duplicates or gaps; ignored dirs: .git, .focus-agent, target, node_modules, vendor, dist, build
state dir (.focus-agent) rejected via resolve_mutation; journaled transaction

files.note: multi-file form: [{path, base_revision?, hunks:[{old, new, occurrence?}]}]; max 16 files, max 64 hunks per call

path.note: single-file shortcut, mutually exclusive with files

limits.note: base_revision mismatch refuses the edit (file changed since it was read); hunks apply in order and each old must match exactly once unless occurrence is given; each file commit is atomic, but a multi-file composite commits sequentially and is not a cross-file transaction; a later failure cleans unattempted preparations and reports any partial application as recovery-required; old content captured to the change journal

old.note: exact text; unambiguous single match unless occurrence/replace_all

limits.note: no-op edits rejected; occurrence and replace_all are mutually exclusive; old content captured to the change journal when the file is small enough
tail bounded; larger output spills to an artifact
tail bounded; larger output spills to an artifact
full log streams to an artifact; bounded ring-buffer tail reaches the model; kill-on-drop and cooperative cancellation

platform.unix: RLIMIT_CPU / RLIMIT_NPROC / RLIMIT_AS / RLIMIT_FSIZE / RLIMIT_NOFILE applied; RLIMIT_CORE forced to 0 on sandbox pre_exec; inherited fds other than stdio closed after landlock; process-group tree kill on cancel
platform.windows: Job Object quotas (active-process + per-process memory ceilings, KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, DIE_ON_UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION); integrity wrap 512 MiB PROCESS_MEMORY on the real child; taskkill /T /F tree kill

argv.note: program and arguments, passed verbatim — no shell parsing

env.note: explicit overrides layered on the inherited environment

limits.note: full log streams to an artifact; bounded ring-buffer tail reaches the model; timeout/cancel kill the whole process tree

argv.note: start: program and arguments, passed verbatim

session_id.note: poll/stop: the id returned by start

limits.note: long-running processes: start returns a session id, poll drains output into the tail + artifact and reports exit, stop kills the whole process tree and reaps the session

schema advertises maximum 64 for search limit, execution clamps to CONTEXT_SEARCH_MAX_LIMIT=50 (execution is authoritative); keep_alive/lease quotas live in the context engine (max_keep_alive_items, max_lease_turns, max_leased_items/tokens per task, max_admits/max_derived per turn)
load/unload move exactly one tool on/off the model surface; process start/stop stays owner-level; registration caps apply to capability-declared schemas

artifacts.note: optional artifact:// refs produced by the completion

limits.note: the tool performs no side effect itself: it attaches a typed RuntimeDirective::CompleteTask that the runtime validates (same caps as a persisted CompletionRecord) and commits at the turn's safe point — after the turn commits, never mid-operation — through the CTX-10 transaction used by /done; a completed task owns exactly one CompletionRecord with the proposal's summary and artifact refs

query.note: optional case-sensitive substring filter on the symbol name

cursor.note: opaque token from a previous code.symbols result; serves the next page from that call's snapshot artifact

limits.note: pure local lexical scan (no language server, no index, no embeddings/vector storage); per-language declaration rules for rs/py/js/jsx/mjs/cjs/ts/tsx/go/c/h/cpp/hpp/cc/hh/cxx/hxx/java/cs/kt/kts/scala/swift/zig; comments, ignored dirs and inline comments skipped; C-like function detection is a documented heuristic; rows are file:line:col  kind name with snapshot-backed cursor paging

input.note: raw diagnostic text (compiler/lint output) containing file:line:col positions

limits.note: parses file:line[:col] positions (rustc --> style included), deduplicates by file+line, resolves each as a workspace-relative confined path and shows surrounding source lines; escaping or missing paths are reported unresolved, never followed; output is hard-bounded by the char budget with skipped-remainder reporting; oversized inputs are truncated

cross_tool_notes.per_tool_output_budget: ToolSpec::output_budget (Option<usize>) declares a model-content cap per tool; the trusted output broker clamps it to MAX_TOOL_MODEL_CONTENT_CHARS and spills at the declared limit (M14).
cross_tool_notes.approval: ReadOnly auto-allows; WorkspaceWrite/ProcessExecution prompt the interactive gate (or deny under --read-only); standing grants (TaskExecutionPolicy, CORE-08) can cover matching effects.
cross_tool_notes.workspace_confinement: all paths resolve through the workspace confinement check (lexical + canonical walk); mutations additionally reject the state dir and use journaled transactions.
cross_tool_notes.model_surface: core + control tools are always on the surface; catalog-optional tools load on demand and cool to unloaded after idle GC; capability tools share the same per-tool lifecycle (Loaded -> Warm -> Unloaded with the same thresholds and TaskAnchor roots) — loading one capability tool never surfaces its siblings; the active task's tool-demand set roots both builtin and capability tools against idle aging; local navigation tools (code.symbols, code.diagnostics) are catalog-optional pure-local scans with no embeddings or vector storage
